1. About these terms

These terms apply to OnlyBody, OnlyWeights and onlybody.app, provided by Illia Khvost, Poland. Questions: support@onlybody.app.

2. What the apps provide

OnlyBody helps you plan and record bodyweight workouts. OnlyWeights focuses on gym routines, reps and weights. Both offer exercise information, session history, rest timers and optional reminders. Product pages show availability and device requirements.

3. Fitness information and safety

The apps provide general fitness information, not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Generated routines, difficulty labels and demonstrations are not a personal assessment of your health or ability. No particular result is guaranteed.

Choose exercises and loads that suit your abilities, using appropriate equipment and technique. Seek qualified advice if you have an injury, health condition or doubts about suitability. Stop if you experience pain, dizziness or other concerning symptoms. Minors should have appropriate parent or guardian involvement and follow applicable age restrictions.

4. App licence and permitted use

Your download is governed by its App Store licence, including Apple’s Standard End User Licence Agreement when no custom EULA is supplied. These terms supplement that licence without replacing its mandatory provisions.

Use the apps and website lawfully. Do not disrupt them, attempt unauthorised access or redistribute protected material without a lawful basis. Legal exceptions remain available. You retain rights in your workout information; software, branding and other content belong to their respective owners.

5. YouTube and external services

The apps use YouTube API Services. By using the apps, you also agree to the YouTube Terms of Service. See the Google Privacy Policy and our YouTube privacy information for data handling.

Videos play through YouTube’s official player and may include ads, links and recommendations. Availability can change. Embedding does not grant permission to download, extract, modify or redistribute videos. External services have their own terms; their use does not imply affiliation with or endorsement by their providers or creators.

6. Your records and privacy

Each app keeps its own local records. Removing it or losing access to your device can cause data loss; review your backup settings. I do not provide cloud sync or account-based recovery. The Privacy Policy explains data handling, your choices and how to delete data.

7. Availability and liability

The apps, website and features may change, be interrupted or be discontinued. Uninterrupted or error-free access is not guaranteed. Material changes will be notified where required by law.

Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited, including for intentional misconduct, or removes mandatory consumer or data-protection rights. The applicable app licence and law also govern your rights and remedies.

8. Ending use and raising concerns

You may stop using the apps or website at any time. For questions, complaints or content concerns, email support@onlybody.app with the app name and relevant details. You remain free to use courts, regulators and other remedies available under applicable law.

9. Updates to these terms

Updates will appear here with a revised date. Material changes will be communicated appropriately and renewed agreement requested where required. Changes do not remove rights or remedies that have already arisen.
